evidence.quote: rehearsals run monthly from now on

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton issues a standing directive from his position, setting the rehearsal cadence by decree rather than by negotiation.
The memo fixes the cadence as an allocation of how the work is to be done, a rank-based declaration rather than a proposal.
The memo allocates ownership to a named person, a rank-based assignment of responsibility.
